description:
A hospital is onboarding a new laboratory department. Before lab staff accounts can be created, the IT security officer must define an appropriate security role.

Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration page (https://localhost/openmrs/admin) and create a new role with the following details:

- Role Name: Lab Technician
- Description: Role for laboratory staff to view patients and manage lab results
- Inherited Roles: None (do not select any)
- Privileges: Select EXACTLY these six privileges:
  1. Get Patients
  2. Get Encounters
  3. Get Observations
  4. Add Observations
  5. Edit Observations
  6. Get Orders

After filling in all fields and checking the six privileges, save the role.

You are logged in as admin (superman / Admin123). The browser is open to the Bahmni home page.
